verified: SpaceX's mission page and Space.com both report that Starship lifted off from Pad 2 at Starbase on Nov. 13, 2026, and that the Ship upper stage was caught by the launch tower on Nov. 14 — the first such catch; CNBC and Wikipedia corroborate that this was the first upper-stage catch/landing after reaching orbit, and Space.com reports that Super Heavy diverted to an offshore splashdown after a low-fuel alarm.
unconfirmed: The booster's explosion after splashdown is described only in Space.com's photo recap, without independent engineering assessment; the sources do not give a root cause for the low-fuel alarm, the Ship's post-catch condition or reusability, or a date for the next flight.

verified: SpaceX 官方飞行页面与维基百科条目均记录，Flight 15 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 22:47 UTC 从得州 Starbase 的 2 号发射台升空，超重型助推器在热分离后返场；飞船（Ship）在轨飞行约 22 小时后于 11 月 14 日返回并被发射塔机械臂捕获，这是首次在入轨后实现上面级直立回收（来源：SpaceX、维基百科、CNBC 报道）。Space.com 现场报道同时确认，助推器因低燃料告警自主改为海上溅落，未进行塔捕。
unconfirmed: Space.com 仅在括号中提及助推器溅落后“爆炸”，未说明是否为受控解体，SpaceX 也未公布细节；被捕获飞船的结构状况、复用检查结果、再次飞行时间表，以及“完全可复用”的时间节点，目前均无官方数据或独立评估支撑。
